messages:
Ava L.: Saturday poll — two options plus one boring adult choice. :thinking_face:
A) Bike to the farmers' market + coffee (early) :bike: :coffee:
B) Lazy brunch + board games (late) :croissant: :game_die:
C) Fix the leaky sink & catch up on chores (very glamorous) :wrench: :sweat_smile:
Vote with emoji or just say which one you want.

Ravi: :bike: market for me. love a good pastry run. what time?

Samir: :zzz: honestly leaning toward a full sleep-in then brunch if anyone's still up.

Olivia: :croissant: brunch + I can bring a box of cards for games. also happy to help with shelf-moving after if needed.

Nadia: :wrench: I can tackle the sink if it's plumbing-related. 50% plants 0% plumbing skills.

Ava L.: perfect. @Ravi thinking 8:30 at the bike racks by the cafe stall?

Ravi: yup 8:30 works. I'll bring cash for pastries and coffee.

Samir: if you pick brunch, save me a croissant before I nap through noon :laughing:

Olivia: vegan pastry stall near the market entrance — I’ll snag a couple. also bringing reusable containers.

Ava L.: @Nadia — do you need any tools? I have a crescent wrench and some plumber's tape I can bring.

Nadia: @Ava L. that would be amazing if you could. thanks!

Samir: I actually have a small crescent wrench in my backpack, bringing that as backup.

Ravi: quick micro-plan — market crew meets at 8:30; brunchers meet at 11:30 at The Green Table; fixer crew texts location + ETA.

deploy-bot: Heads up — office moving boxes are still by the kitchen. Please reclaim anything that belongs to you before Monday. :package:

Olivia: lol thanks bot 

Ava L.: votes so far: :bike: x2, :croissant: x2, :wrench: x2 (balanced chaos). See y'all saturday!
